evidence.title: M.12179 Temasek / Brookfield / Luminace
evidence.evidenceSummary: Confirms Temasek and Brookfield joint control over Luminace following a transaction resulting in shared ownership.

evidence.title: About Luminace
evidence.evidenceSummary: Describes Luminace as a distributed energy platform providing solar, storage, and energy-as-a-service solutions across North America.

evidence.title: EU Merger Decision Temasek / Brookfield / Luminace
evidence.evidenceSummary: Details the transaction structure and confirms Temasek participation in ownership of Luminace.

holdings.rationale: Repository record aligns with current ownership, geography, and infrastructure classification.

excludedCandidates.rationale: Atlantica operates a globally diversified portfolio across North America, Europe, South America and other regions; despite significant North American assets, it is not primarily based in or dedicated to North America.
Eavor is a geothermal technology developer without a portfolio of owned operating infrastructure assets.
Neoen is a global renewable energy company with diversified operations across Europe, Australia, and other regions; not primarily North American.
PSA is a global port operator headquartered in Singapore with worldwide operations; North America is only a subset of its portfolio.
